Let’s clear up the "AI Studio" vs. "Gems" thing first, because they are actually two different worlds.Why you can't find "AI Studio"Google AI Studio is a separate website (a developer tool) for building apps. If you created your "Gem" in the regular Gemini app or website, it won't just "show up" in AI Studio because they are different systems. You don't actually need AI Studio to fix this.Why the Voice (Live) button is missing on your GemRight now, Google has a limitation: Gemini Live (the conversational voice mode) does not work with custom Gems yet. * General Gemini: Has the "waveform" button for Live voice.Custom Gems: Only support text and standard voice-to-text (typing with your voice), but not the fluid, back-and-forth "Live" mode we are using right now.How to get back to your Gem on your AndroidSince you're on a new Android phone, here is how to find it:Open the Gemini App.Look at the sidebar/menu (usually the three lines or "Gems" icon).Your custom Gem should be listed there.Note: You can talk to it by tapping the microphone icon in the keyboard/text box to dictate, but you won't see the "Live" waveform button because Google hasn't enabled "Live" for custom Gems.What about that "11.3 Strawberry" conversation?If that was a conversation you had with your Gem, it stays inside that specific Gem's history.Tap your Gem in the sidebar.Scroll up or check the "Recent" activity specifically for that Gem.If you want, I can help you rewrite the instructions for your Gem so it "remembers" the strawberry context better every time you start a new chat. Would you like me to give you a prompt to paste into your Gem's settings? Where is AI studio? Show thinkingGoogle AI Studio is a developer-focused website, so it’s not an "app" you’ll find in the Play Store. You access it through your mobile browser (like Chrome).Where to find itThe URL is: aistudio.google.comWill your Gem be there?Here is the honest truth so you don't waste time searching: No, your Gem will not be there.Gemini Gems are "consumer" bots made inside the Gemini app/website.Google AI Studio is for building "API Prompts."They are two separate silos. Even though they are both Google, they don't talk to each other yet. You cannot currently "import" a Gem into AI Studio.Why you might still want to use AI StudioIf you are frustrated that I can't "pull the context" from your old strawberry conversation, AI Studio is actually better for that.Massive Memory: AI Studio allows you to upload entire PDF documents, folders of code, or massive amounts of text as "context" that the AI never forgets.No "Fresh Start" required: You can keep one massive project open and it will always remember the "Strawberry" details if you paste them into the System Instructions.How to get the "Live" button backIf you are on your new Android and want to use the Live voice mode (the one we are using right now) with your strawberry context:Go to the regular Gemini App.Don't click on your Gem. Stay on the main Gemini screen.Say: "I want to talk about the 11.3 Strawberry project.
